sql: WITH most_influential_user AS (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)), user_posts AS (SELECT p.Id, p.Score FROM posts p JOIN most_influential_user u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id) SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(Id), 0) AS percentage FROM user_posts;
